items.title: Blue Chips Pop On Blue Wave As Dow Surges 1,000 Points
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,009 points, or 1.9%, at Wednesday’s open, according to ABC News. The move came the morning after midterm results showed Democrats taking control of the U.S. House and Senate. ABC News put the S&P 500 and the NASDAQ Composite each up 1.1%.
